Question: assalam alaikum, my question is : Is "Zakah" wajib on raw gold (not a piece of Jewellery- but a block of gold cut from a 24 carat gold brick)? Answer ID: 16646 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1949/1542/D=1430) It will also be liable for Zakah.
